nodes.text:
🚨 Indian Govt clears confusion on HMPV virus.

They said-

1) HMPV is not a new virus, no need to panic.

2) It was first identified in 2001 and it has been circulating in the entire world since many years.

The virus spreads in winter. This can affect persons of all age groups. https://t.co/juIlDE6akm
